note: Asserted by frontend/src/lib/matching/__tests__/leadProjectMatching.test.js under VITEST, not pytest — ALG-10 governs frontend code. Each case calls matchLeadToProjects(evaluacion, proyectos) and compares the whole returned object, order included. Capacity values in `evaluacion` are given literally rather than recomputed: ALG-10 never computes capacity, and pinning them here keeps these cases independent of ALG-9. Every ratio the pair-scoped math needs arrives inside capacidad_supuestos, so no capacity constant is declared on the frontend (spike §8.3). A number changed in code but not here turns the build red.

cases.name: comuna_alternativa_es_declaracion_no_preferencia
cases.why: R2.2 + R4 branch 3a. The lead declared Nunoa with Macul as alternative. Altos de Macul takes NO comuna penalty and is NOT re-orientable -- they already pointed there. Parque Lo Espejo is outside comunas_declaradas and takes the full -15, re-orientable. Pins the resolution of the contradiction with the shipped HU 2 filter (DashboardLeads.jsx:225-227), which already treats main and alternativa as equal matches.

cases.name: desempate_prefiere_comuna_principal
cases.why: R6 first tie-break, constructed so proyecto_id ordering CANNOT produce the answer: the alternative-comuna project is 'a-alt' and the main-comuna one is 'z-main', so alphabetical order would put the alternative first. Identical afinidad (both single-price at 2100, both inside comunas_declaradas, so neither takes the comuna penalty) -- only the main-comuna tie-break can put z-main first. This is where R2.2's flattened preference signal is recovered: an ordering rule, not a weight.

cases.name: holgura_parcial_ordena_y_marca_reorientable
cases.why: R2 with every component firing at once, plus R6 ordering across three projects. Spike §9.2 recomputed at uf_value_clp = 40695. Altos de Macul: holgura -7.2, comuna -15, clasif -8, blocker high -7 -> 62.8 Cercano, re-orientable because the comuna diverges, and the executive is told the lead needs ~$1,05 MM more in savings to reach the top of the range.

cases.name: clears_price_range_sin_bloqueador_fabricado
cases.why: R3 guard, the load-bearing one. The lead clears Parque Lo Espejo's whole range so brecha_valor_uf is 0, steps 2-3 are SKIPPED, and the card falls through to the lead-level pie_insuficiente (step 4) with brecha_recurso_clp null. Without the guard it would claim pie_insuficiente_para_proyecto for a pair that has no such shortfall.

cases.name: proyecto_precio_unico_no_produce_nan
cases.why: Invariant 3 / R2.1: precio_min_uf == precio_max_uf is a valid single-price project. The 'capacidad >= precio_max -> 0' branch must run before interpolating. Also pins the tipo penalty (-10, casa vs departamento declarado).

cases.name: e2_lead_medio_holgado
cases.why: HU 10 E2, half one. A Medio lead sitting above precio_max, no declared preferences, no blockers. Compare with e2_lead_alto_ajustado: the test asserts this afinidad is strictly greater, which is 'capacity beats classification' expressed as a test.

cases.name: e2_lead_alto_ajustado
cases.why: HU 10 E2, half two. An Alto lead scraping precio_min on the same project takes the full -45 holgura penalty and lands below the Medio lead above.

cases.name: cercania_bajo_precio_min_entra_como_no_alcanza
cases.why: R1 near-miss band. Capacity 3071.6 is below precio_min 3800 but clears 0.80 x 3800 = 3040, so the pair stays in matches with alcanza_precio_min false. precio_ref becomes precio_min ('what it takes to qualify at all') per R3's third rule -- quoting precio_max here would overstate the gap by the whole width of the project.

cases.name: fuera_de_alcance_excluido_de_verdad
cases.why: R1 G2. Below 0.80 x precio_min with no FOGAES route, so the pair is genuinely excluded. This is the case the band still refuses -- softening G2 did not remove it.

cases.name: fogaes_vivienda_nueva_rescata_lead_de_entrada
cases.why: R1 assisted inclusion + R5. Perfil entrada: capacity 1474.4 is under 0.80 x 2100 = 1680, so the conservative gate would drop them. They declared vivienda_nueva, the project is under the FOGAES cap, and their savings already cover the 10% pie -- so inclusion tests the assisted ceiling (2573.6) and they appear, ranked on the CONSERVATIVE number and flagged desbloqueable_con_fogaes. This is the first-home segment the 20% anchor would otherwise lose.

cases.name: holgura_en_tope_precio_unico_cuesta_12
cases.why: R2.1's precio_max anchor on a single-price project. The lead can exactly afford it -- zero margin -- and pays HOLGURA_EN_TOPE = 12, NOT the precio_min anchor of 45. A lead who clears a single-price project reaches 100% of its inventory; what they lack is margin for gastos operacionales, not inventory reach.

cases.name: sobrecalce_saturado_ordena_ultimo
cases.why: R2.1 upper tail. A lead with 4.6x the project price saturates at SOBRECALCE_MAX = 20 -- the inversionista at 2x is NOT penalised this hard (saturation is 3.0), which is the whole reason that constant moved off 2.0.

cases.name: bloqueador_critico_excluye_antes_que_capacidad
cases.why: G1 before G2. A critical blocker excludes every pair with motivo bloqueador_critico even where the lead could afford the project, because commercial_priority.py already refuses to route them (do_not_route). bloqueador_principal reports the critical blocker (step 1).

cases.name: requires_info_excluye_todo_sin_puntuar
cases.why: G0 / A2. Capacity is null, so nothing is rankable: every project lands in excluidos with capacidad_requiere_antecedentes and bloqueador_principal null. These are leads needing a fresh evaluation, never leads with zero capacity.

cases.name: sin_comuna_ni_project_fit_nunca_reorientable
cases.why: R4's stated negative consequence, pinned so it is not later rediscovered as a bug. No comuna declared (branch 3a cannot fire) and project_fit.status is requires_info rather than out_of_reach/near (branch 3b cannot fire), so a Compatible pair is still reorientable=false. You cannot re-orient someone who never stated a direction.

cases.name: renta_vinculante_brecha_en_ingreso
cases.why: R3 step 3: an income-bound lead gets renta_insuficiente_para_proyecto and the gap is expressed in monthly income, computed through the annuity factor under the same capacidad_supuestos the capacity used (plazo 25, not the default 30).

cases.name: bloqueadores_no_criticos_topan_en_15
cases.why: R2 last row: three high blockers would subtract 21, but the component is capped at 15. Step 4 then reports the highest-severity one by declaration order in blockers.py.
